double_couple_from_nodal_plane.formula: Aki-Richards symmetric double-couple tensor convention; P axis = eigenvector of minimum eigenvalue
double_couple_from_nodal_plane.nodal_plane_equivalence_gate: when NP2 exists, |dot(P1,P2)| >= 0.995 else event abstains

moment_tensor_fallback.second_choice: tensor components if a complete six-component symmetric tensor is present

local_frame.canonical_fault_tangent: finite-difference tangent of immutable GEM polyline at snapped along-fault coordinate
local_frame.path_oriented_tangent: canonical tangent multiplied by frozen edge tangent sign

static_field_residualization.segment_mean: arg(mean(exp(2i*psi)))/2 on TRAIN only under canonical tangent
static_field_residualization.edge_orientation: multiply canonical axial angle and segment mean by frozen tangent sign before child-minus-parent difference

concentration.resultant: mean cos(2*residual) under normalized TRAIN parent weights
concentration.kappa_inverse: standard circular resultant approximation; kappa capped at 500
